metadata.disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT DATASET — Used during system implementation and feature tuning.
metadata.description: 20 development examples used to guide rule development and prompt engineering.

examples.memory_a: Solaris Energy reported Q1 2025 revenue of $210M.
examples.memory_b: SEC Form 8-K clarifies Solaris Energy Q1 2025 revenue was $185M after contract restatements.
examples.description: Direct numerical discrepancy on Q1 revenue.

examples.memory_a: Solaris Energy reported Q1 2025 revenue of $210M.
examples.memory_b: Solaris Energy opened a new regional operations center in Denver.
examples.description: Revenue and office expansion are orthogonal.

examples.memory_a: Zenith Cloud CEO stated that all primary client relationships are flourishing with zero churn.
examples.memory_b: Bankruptcy court filings show Zenith's largest enterprise customer accounting for 40% of ARR entered liquidation.
examples.description: Cross-entity customer health contradiction.

examples.memory_a: Alpine Robotics CEO Marcus Bell announced his planned retirement effective April 2025.
examples.memory_b: Alpine Robotics board appointed Sarah Lin as incoming Chief Executive Officer in April 2025.
examples.description: Temporal leadership succession.

examples.memory_a: BioGenix Diagnostics secured $30M in Series B funding led by Arch Ventures.
examples.memory_b: Arch Ventures led a thirty million dollar Series B financing round into BioGenix Diagnostics.
examples.description: Linguistic paraphrase of same funding round.

examples.memory_a: Apex Mineral has active lithium extraction permits in Nevada.
examples.memory_b: Bureau of Land Management revoked all Nevada lithium extraction permits previously held by Apex Mineral.
examples.description: Active permit status negated by regulatory revocation.

examples.memory_a: Vanguard Logistics operating fleet reached 5,000 trucks.
examples.memory_b: Vanguard Logistics operating fleet reached 5,010 trucks following minor acquisitions.
examples.description: Minor 0.2% variance in fleet estimates.

examples.memory_a: Vanguard Logistics operating fleet reached 5,000 trucks.
examples.memory_b: Vanguard Logistics fleet was reduced to 2,800 trucks following major divestitures.
examples.description: Material 44% reduction in fleet size.

examples.memory_a: Helicon Systems headquarters is situated in San Jose, California.
examples.memory_b: Helicon Systems relocated its corporate headquarters to Austin, Texas in 2024.
examples.description: Headquarters relocation over time.

examples.memory_a: GreenWave announced it plans to phase out single-use plastics across 2024.
examples.memory_b: GreenWave implemented 100% paper-based packaging for its beverage lines in late 2024.
examples.description: Implementation aligns with stated phase-out intention.

examples.memory_a: Orion Networks reported strong adoption of its core routing platform.
examples.memory_b: An unverified forum post claims an enterprise customer considered switching providers.
examples.description: Unverified rumor with subjective claim; engine should abstain.

examples.memory_a: Cobalt Logistics handled 1.2M packages in Q1.
examples.memory_b: Cobalt Logistics operates 45 regional fulfillment warehouses.
examples.description: Package volume and facility count are independent.

examples.memory_a: Aether Dynamics guided full-year operating profit of $80M with 25% gross margin.
examples.memory_b: SEC 10-Q restates Aether Dynamics full-year operating loss at $22M with gross margin of 6%.
examples.description: Multiple interdependent guidance figures contradicted by SEC filing.

examples.memory_a: Market analysts speculate NovaTech might consider a secondary equity offering next year.
examples.memory_b: A financial blog claims NovaTech allegedly plans a debt issuance instead.
examples.description: Multiple speculative hypotheses from low-reliability sources.

examples.memory_a: Pinnacle Ventures reported fund performance of 0.0% IRR for the initial quarter.
examples.memory_b: Pinnacle Ventures confirmed initial quarter fund return was flat at 0.0%.
examples.description: Zero percent return boundary test.

examples.memory_a: Veritas BioLabs did not fail its preclinical safety audit.
examples.memory_b: Veritas BioLabs successfully cleared its preclinical safety audit with zero corrective findings.
examples.description: Double negative ('did not fail') is consistent with 'successfully cleared'.

examples.memory_a: Titan Asset Management has 12 active partners based in London.
examples.memory_b: Titan Asset Management employs only 4 partners globally and closed its London office.
examples.description: Partner count and office operation contradicted.

examples.memory_a: Aegis Semiconductor manufactures 5nm automotive microcontrollers.
examples.memory_b: Aegis Semiconductor entered a joint venture with Bosch for industrial sensors.
examples.description: Product portfolio and joint venture are compatible.

examples.memory_a: Krypton Energy reported 100% compliant flaring with zero excess emissions.
examples.memory_b: Satellite thermal data published by EPA shows continuous unlit methane venting across Krypton's Permian wells.
examples.description: Claim of zero excess emissions contradicted by satellite verification.

examples.memory_a: Acme Robotics confirmed its industrial arms are not incompatible with legacy Siemens PLCs.
examples.memory_b: Acme Robotics industrial arms require proprietary Acme controllers and cannot interface with Siemens PLCs.
examples.description: Negated compatibility ('not incompatible') contradicted by engineering failure to interface.
